title: Add Bold Tag in String
goal: Wrap matching substrings in the fewest bold-tag ranges, merging overlaps and adjacency.
strategy: At each character, extend the farthest match end from dictionary words beginning there. A coverage mask marks the union of matches; open and close tags only when that mask changes.
